description: This file contains the core business logic and API interaction functions for managing notes, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, listing, searching, and listing tags. It defines data classes for requests, utility functions for converting database objects to dictionaries, and functions that interact with a database session and models such as Note and Tag.

classes.name: ListNotesRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for listing notes with optional filters and sorting.

classes.name: SearchNotesRequest
classes.description: Data class for search query parameters specifying the search mode and pagination.

methods.name: dict _note_to_out_dict(note: Note)
methods.description: Converts a Note database object into a dictionary for API output.

methods.name: None _ensure_tags_exist(db: Database, tags: list[str])
methods.description: Ensures all tags in the list exist in the database by inserting missing tags.

methods.name: dict create_note_flow(db: Database, *, title: str, content: str, tags: list[str])
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title, content, and tags, returning its serialized dictionary.

methods.name: dict get_note_flow(db: Database, *, note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a note by its ID, raising NotFoundError if it does not exist.

methods.name: dict update_note_flow(db: Database, *, note_id: int, patch: dict)
methods.description: Updates an existing note with patch data, including title, content, and tags, returning the updated note dict.

methods.name: None delete_note_flow(db: Database, *, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, raising NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: tuple[list[dict],int] list_notes_flow(db: Database, req: ListNotesRequest)
methods.description: Lists notes with optional filtering by tag and query, supports pagination and sorting.

methods.name: tuple[list[dict],int] search_notes_flow(db: Database, req: SearchNotesRequest)
methods.description: Searches notes based on a query and mode ('title', 'content', 'tags', or all), supports pagination.

methods.name: list[dict] list_tags_flow(db: Database)
methods.description: Lists all tags with an approximate count of associated notes.
